About.title: ABOUT ME
About.description: Full Stack Systems Developer with end-to-end experience developing and maintaining enterprise and Web applications. Strong command of Java (Spring Boot), Node.js, PostgreSQL, and the Web ecosystem (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, Vue.js). Solid track record designing RESTful APIs, scalable system architecture, and third-party service integration. Analytical profile focused on problem-solving, security best practices, automated testing, and delivering results in collaborative environments.

experiences.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
description: Provided technical leadership for the frontend team of a public investment management system for the State of Ceará.
Implemented reusable components and custom libraries to optimize performance and consistency across projects.
Collaborated directly with design and backend teams on API integration, ensuring product functionality and usability.
Tracked best practices and emerging technologies to keep projects current and efficient.
Defined frontend architecture.
Made technical decisions.
Conducted code reviews.
Oversaw delivery tracking.

experiences.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
description: Contributed to the development of the Ventus platform and led the frontend development team for the Cinemax platform.
Implemented features and reusable components with React and TypeScript.
Built cross-platform mobile applications with React Native and desktop applications with Electron.
Integrated RESTful APIs for backend communication and optimized performance and SEO in Next.js applications.
Participated in code reviews and mentored junior developers.

experiences.title: TEACHER & SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
description: Taught programming logic using C.
Taught Algorithms and Data Structures.
Developed corporate desktop applications with Java (Java SE), JDBC, and MySQL.
Developed web applications with Java (JSP) on Tomcat and MySQL, and with Java (JSF + PrimeFaces) on WildFly and PostgreSQL.
Developed and deployed APIs with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.
